results.title: The man who took Nepal to Lord’s now wants a British PM in Nepal
results.content: Prashanta Kunwar pitched a Nepal match at the home of cricket when few would listen. Now he has asked a British prime minister to visit Nepal.

results.title: Supreme Court declines interim order in Dan Bahadur Karki’s petition
results.content: The court has directed an expedited hearing, citing the importance and sensitivity of leadership and the chain of command within the Nepal Police.

results.title: Election Commission updates Nepali Congress leadership and amended statute
results.content: The commission has formally recognised the party’s new 231-member central committee, elected at its 15th general convention, and amendments to its statute.

results.title: The killings have a name: Femicide. Nepal’s law does not recognise it
results.content: An investigation of 489 homicide cases across all 77 districts identified 107 femicides — more than one in five. Most victims had endured domestic violence before they were killed. Yet Nepal has no separate legal category or official count for such killings.

results.title: Your thesis was flagged as AI-written. Now what?
results.content: Nepal’s universities need clear academic integrity policies, not detection software that punishes students on guesswork.

results.title: Seven takeaways from Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s India visit
results.content: From a two-way air route to an eight-MoU haul, here is what Kathmandu got from Delhi, what it left on the table and what went missing altogether.

results.title: Nepal crash out of Asia Cup Rising Stars after 96-run defeat to Pakistan A
results.content: Nepal were bowled out for 72 while chasing 169, suffering their second heavy batting collapse in three matches.

results.title: Delayed ordinances signal a rift between Nepal president and prime minister
results.content: Sheetal Niwas questions the urgency of bypassing Parliament to amend the Press Council Act and Nepal Airlines Corporation Act, as constitutional experts warn against indefinite delays.

results.title: India agreements open new opportunities for Nepal’s tourism
results.content: Tourism entrepreneurs expect two-way flights through Bhairahawa and the Ayodhya-Janakpur rail service to help double Indian visitor arrivals.

results.title: Nepal to import 20,000 tonnes of DAP fertiliser within a week
results.content: The shipment is expected to boost supplies for winter crops, with the state-owned Krishi Samagri Company Limited saying existing stocks and incoming supplies will meet seasonal demand.

results.title: Nepal forecast to receive above-normal precipitation this winter
results.content: ICIMOD warns of increased rainfall in the foothills and heavier snowfall at higher elevations, raising the risk of floods, landslides and avalanches in parts of the western Himalaya.

results.title: Nepal to get an IIT campus under new education agreement
results.content: Announced during Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to India, the proposed campus is expected to strengthen cooperation in technical education, research and innovation.

results.title: Over 600 Nepali workers in Romania report pay and accommodation dispute
results.content: Workers allege that a Romanian logistics firm is offering lower wages than those promised in their contracts and seeking to charge them for accommodation that was supposed to be free.

results.title: Ayodhya-Janakpur train arrives with 1,000 passengers
results.content: The Saryu-Kamala Express was flagged off by the prime ministers of Nepal and India in New Delhi on Monday before departing from Ayodhya.
